raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer — Mitrahsoft
Built concurrent background-job pipelines (Worker Pool, Fan-In/Fan-Out) and resolved Kubernetes pod crashes via controlled goroutine execution.
Developed microservices using gRPC and Kafka-based event-driven pipelines, with Elasticsearch/Kibana/APM monitoring and alerting. ● Developed automated test cases for desktop application testing using Playwright (TypeScript) and RobotJS. ● Implemented multilingual support using go-i18n and loaded application logs into Snowflake for analytical reporting. ● Developed a serverless Campaign Mail Scheduler (AWS Lambda, SQS, SendGrid) for event-driven bulk email processing. ● Served as an LLM Trainer (Turing) on Amazon Nova prompt engineering and response evaluation, achieving ~95% unit test coverage. ● Delivered cross-stack features spanning Vue.js dashboards, AWS S3 file handling, OAuth integrations, and CI/CD automation (Jenkins, Docker).
Front-End Development Trainee — Besant Technologies
Completed a 6-month intensive ReactJS front-end training program, building practice applications covering component design, state management, and API integration.
raw_sections.projects:
KEY PROJECTS
Ecommerce Application

Integrated Firebase Authentication with backend JWT verification (Firebase Admin SDK, Golang) and RBAC for USER/ADMIN roles; used AES encryption for sensitive data.
Built a scalable Order Management and Inventory System with transactional consistency and idempotent APIs to prevent duplicate transactions.
Designed a Wallet System using double-entry ledger for ACID-compliant transactions, with fraud detection, transaction validation, and

audit logging. Integrated Stripe payments (sandbox), Firebase Cloud Messaging for real-time notifications, and Firestore for real-time order tracking/chat sync; built a WebSocket-based rule-driven chatbot in Golang for customer support workflows.
HRMS — Human Resource Management System

Improved legacy code and MongoDB query performance by adding indexes and removing nested loops, cutting report generation time from 5 minutes to 25 seconds for 1 lakh (100,000+) records. Implemented Go concurrency patterns (Worker Pool, Fan-In/Fan-Out) for background PDF and Excel report generation.
● Resolved Kubernetes pod crashes from high-memory jobs using controlled goroutine execution and gopsutil-based memory checks, improving scalability under load. Integrated Elasticsearch/Kibana dashboards and alerting; built AWS S3 file upload, encryption, and pre-signed URL features.
● Developed an Expense microservice with approval workflows and Tesseract OCR-based receipt data extraction.
Freight Management System — Microservices
Implemented gRPC-based inter-service communication and a Kafka-driven event system for real-time parcel tracking. ● Built event deduplication logic and used Cadence workflow orchestration for retrying and reprocessing failed events. ● Generated freight bills and shipping labels via ZPL, and implemented fuel-price and carrier-discount business rules. ● Used PostgreSQL for transactional data and Cassandra for high-volume tracking events; managed schema migrations. ● Applied dependency injection (samber/do) to reduce coupling; wrote unit/integration tests using a TDD approach.
